chars.ABDELLAH: ABDELLAH: a man in his early thirties wearing a mustard-yellow quilted vest over a white long-sleeve shirt, dark blue jeans, brown leather shoes.
chars.ASMAE: ASMAE: a young woman wearing a plain emerald-green headscarf, a long lilac house kaftan with small white embroidery at the collar, pink slippers.
chars.DUNYA: DUNYA: a young woman with a short black bob haircut drawn as a flat black cap shape, wearing an oversized red-and-black checked flannel shirt, black sweatpants, white sneakers.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: In a Moroccan family living room in Casablanca with a round low table full of dinner dishes (tagine, bread, mint tea), DUNYA sits very close to ASMAE and leans toward her with an unsettling smile, while ASMAE leans away, tense and uncomfortable. Warm evening lamp light.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Close medium shot at the same dinner table: DUNYA puts her hand on top of ASMAE's hand on the table and talks to her quietly; ASMAE freezes and stares at the hand, eyes wide, shocked.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: ASMAE stands up suddenly from the low dinner table, pulling back with a shocked open mouth, a tea glass tipping over; DUNYA stays seated, looking up at her calmly. Moroccan living room with sedari sofas.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: ASMAE alone in a small Moroccan kitchen at night, leaning against the counter with both hands on her chest, worried and thinking hard, a single hanging lamp, the door half closed behind her.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: In the same living room, ABDELLAH comes home smiling, carrying a plastic bag of bread and vegetables; ASMAE greets him with a forced, nervous smile, hiding her worry, hands clasped tightly.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: ASMAE sits on a sofa pretending to fold laundry while secretly glancing sideways at DUNYA, who walks past in the hallway in the background without looking at her. Tense quiet atmosphere, afternoon light.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Early morning in the entrance of a Moroccan apartment: ABDELLAH opens the front door to leave for work, holding his keys and a small shop bag, the soft blue dawn light coming from the stairwell.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: A modest Moroccan bedroom in early morning: ASMAE sleeps peacefully in bed under a thick patterned blanket (fully covered, in her lilac kaftan). The bedroom door is slightly open and a dark silhouette shadow of someone stands in the bright doorway, watching. Suspenseful mood.
